brand.name: WorkBridge
brand.tagline: Connecting skilled workers with global opportunities

landing.title: Connecting skilled workers with global opportunities
landing.copy: WorkBridge connects drivers, chefs, electricians, mechanics, plumbers, welders, painters and construction workers with employers, and helps manage overseas recruitment, documents and visa processing.
landing.workspacesSub: Built for blue-collar recruitment, overseas placement and visa management.
landing.workerCardCopy: Search jobs, apply, manage your documents, compare salaries, ask the assistant and track your visa milestones.
landing.employerCardCopy: Post listings, review matched candidates with the reasons behind each score, shortlist, schedule interviews and hire.
landing.consultancyCardCopy: Manage authorised recruitment cases, record milestone updates and track document status.
landing.adminCardCopy: Platform metrics, listing review queue, account management and a full audit trail.
landing.statNote: Figures are read live from this deployment's database.
